capabilities: Render notes with custom CSS themes in a live preview
Upload local images to the WeChat media library
Sync rendered articles to the WeChat draft box
Extract the first image as the article cover
Copy rendered rich text to the clipboard
disambiguation: Not a two-way file sync; it pushes rendered articles one way into WeChat Official Account drafts.
extras: Your computer's public IP must be added to the WeChat IP whitelist, and changing proxy/VPN nodes breaks sync. The AppSecret is shown only once. Free and open source under AGPLv3.
motivation: The author says automatic image upload was the biggest pain point and had to be supported from version 1.0.
problem: Publishing a styled note to a WeChat Official Account otherwise means reformatting the article by hand and re-uploading every image.

relations.evidence: Similar to the mdnice experience, the left side is OB's native note-taking area

summary: Renders Markdown notes with custom CSS themes and pushes them, images included, into WeChat Official Account drafts.
